sql: select 'ims' src, count(distinct market_ticker) mk, count(*) n, min(at) from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' and at > now() - interval '3 days' union all select 'ob', count(distinct market_ticker), count(*), min(captured_at) from orderbook_snapshots where market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' and captured_at > now() - interval '3 days' union all select 'ms', count(distinct market_ticker), count(*), min(captured_at) from market_snapshots where market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' and captured_at > now() - interval '3 days'
